acceptance_criteria: T001-T018 use paper equations, standard material models, and printed scalar quantities without source pixels, author code, or author arrays.
The MZI and two-photon lift are unitary, probabilities normalize, and declared limits are recovered.
Scalar mode, grating, reflectivity, and electrode-loss reconstructions remain explicitly approximate.
Fail closed until author point-level CSV files exist with hashes.
If inputs become available, independently fit and recompute experimental derived quantities.
Never use synthetic arrays or digitized source pixels as substitutes for measurements.
Evaluate the type-0 phase mismatch from independently solved scalar modes while exposing the missing vector-FEM inputs.
Recover the fourfold detected-signal ratio from the ideal Fock maxima and binomial 50:50 detector separation.
Prove the ten-waveguide geometric span and expose the unpublished crosstalk and edge-clearance convention.
Do not promote reduced implementation attestation to scientific coverage.
